jcr:content.jcr:title: Booking a seat for your infant

master.answer:
Infants under 2 years of age do not require a seat but will be seated on the lap of the adult travelling with them.

If you would prefer to book a seat for your infant under two years, contact us or your travel agent to make the booking. Infants occupying a seat will pay a discounted fare. The booking can not be made via Qantas.com.

Infants occupying a seat must be restrained in an approved child car seat or restraint. Refer to Child restraints onboard aircraft.
